structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions

law.catch_line: Transfer of patient by physician who refuses to comply with advance directive or health care decision
law.text: An attending physician who refuses to comply with (i) a patient's advance directive or (ii) the health care decision of a patient's agent or (iii) the health care decision of an authorized person pursuant to § 54.1-2986 shall make a reasonable effort to transfer the patient to another physician and shall comply with § 54.1-2990. This section shall apply even if the attending physician determines the health care requested to be medically or ethically inappropriate.
